title: Account Specialist at Regional IT Reseller Expects Databricks-Related Business to Grow 20%–25% in 2026
expert: Account specialist, large regional IT reseller (65%-70% public sector customers; current)
verdict: This regional reseller's Databricks practice grew 15%-18% in public sector and 30%, 35%-40% in commercial in Aug-Oct, with consumption up around 20% on usage rather than price, though only about 15% of expansion deals include newer products.
